scope: Material and Mechanical Mother corrosion condition transfer across steel plate, lock and air-conditioner shell
boundedQuestion: Can one corrosion state prove real outward geometry displacement across plate, lock and air-conditioner shell without shader-only fallback or unexplained top/side morphology drift?

facts: Rust must alter geometry rather than only color.
Green spot corrosion must protrude rather than remain a color-only mark.
Corrosion function 2-1-1-2 is valuable and should remain in audition, but its top and bottom planar faces look stretched and fake compared with the side surface.
The same corrosion relation should transfer to locks and air-conditioner shells.

relationshipToExistingRegression.nonDuplicateDelta: The existing case verifies substrate/protection/exposure provenance for a corrosion condition. It does not verify actual mesh displacement, material-geometry field binding, face-orientation slices, or cross-asset transfer.

sourceFacts.boundedFact: An oxide/metal volume ratio above one means the oxide occupies more volume; very high ratios can generate compressive stress and cracking.
sourceFacts.excludedUse: Not a visual recipe, asset-specific displacement amplitude, renderer recommendation, or current qualification authority.

negativeControls.name: green spot has no outward displacement
top face differs from side without a bound orientation cause
shader and geometry use different corrosion fields

positiveControl.input: shared corrosion field + distinct reference/deformed mesh digests + nonzero outward displacement + top/side slices + plate/lock/air-conditioner transfer + independent verifier

outOfScope: Automatic replacement of production corrosion functions

requestedResponse: principles, code or data worth learning
